name: kwakseongjae/oh-my-design
description: Design-system skill collection with a DESIGN.md reference archive, covering CJK-screen design and related UI work, installed through an interactive CLI installer with a doctor check command. Note: Requires user-supplied API credentials for external data access.
install: npx oh-my-design-cli@latest (interactive installer with per-agent flags and a doctor check command), plus npx oh-my-design-cli@latest install-skills --agent <name> --all
